about:
South Jersey Circuits, LLC operates from Burlington, New Jersey, providing printed circuit board assembly services to a range of industrial sectors. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders in its public materials.

The shop specializes in PCB and circuit board assembly, utilizing pick-and-place equipment for surface-mount technology. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published, and the company does not list additional processes such as through-hole assembly or box build.

The company serves customers in the medical, aerospace, automotive, and military sectors. All assembly work is performed in the United States, a point the firm highlights as a benefit of American craftsmanship and faster turnaround times.

South Jersey Circuits emphasizes a quality policy built on 100 percent customer satisfaction, competitive pricing, and on-time delivery as its primary differentiators. The company positions itself as an assembly shop that customers can trust for domestic production.
